description: The dataset contains 20 atmospheric balloon‑sounding records collected on 18 August 2018, each stamped with a second‑resolution date‑time. Every entry provides geographic coordinates (longitude 0 to 37.12°, latitude 0 to 89.56°) and a height ranging from near the surface up to 701.6 m. Atmospheric measurements include pressure (PPPP) from 919 to 1003.75 hPa, temperature (TTT) between –2.34 °C and 0 °C, relative humidity (RH) up to 95.3 %, wind direction (dd) spanning 0 to 277°, and wind speed (ff) up to 12.39 m s⁻¹. All rows share the same event identifier “Balloon_20180818_1109_1139”. This collection can be used to analyse vertical profiles of pressure, temperature, humidity and wind for a single balloon launch, to validate atmospheric models, or to study boundary‑layer dynamics.
